nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances per address; mutated by transfers, team fee and reflection logic.
Total reflection supply, reduced by rFee in _reflectFee; read by _getCurrentSupply/_getRate.
Payable address that receives ETH collected by the contract fees.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Mapping marking addresses exempt from the transfer fees.
Uniswap V2 router instance set in openTrading and used for swaps/liquidity.
Address of the created SOE/WETH pair, targeted by transfers and approvals.
Reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap during token-to-ETH swaps.
Flag enabling automatic fee swapping, activated by openTrading.
Maximum transaction amount; initialized to the full supply.
Tax fee percentage used by _getTValues, mutated inside _transfer.
Team fee percentage used by _getTValues, mutated inside _transfer.
Owner address used by the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
One-shot flag that gates openTrading.
Accumulated token fees tracked by _reflectFee.
External caller-supplied address used as token holder, owner and transfer origin.
Miner-influenceable timestamp passed as the deadline to Uniswap calls.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that performs a transfer then decreases the allowance.
Public ERC20 approve that delegates to the private _approve helper.
Core transfer routine that sets fees, conditionally swaps tokens for ETH and forwards to the fee wallet.
Swaps contract tokens for ETH through the Uniswap router, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Sends ETH to the fee wallet using a raw transfer.
Owner-only initializer that sets the router, creates the pair and adds liquidity.
Applies reflection math, updates _rOwned balances, takes team fee and reflects the fee.
Credits the team fee reflections to the contract address in _rOwned.
Reduces _rTotalAmt by rFee and increases _tFeeTotalAmt by tFee.
Computes t/r amount, transfer amount and fee breakdown for a transfer.
Derives token fee, team fee and transfer amount from the amount and fee percentages.
Derives reflection amount, fee and transfer amount using the current rate.
Computes the reflection to token supply ratio used by all conversions.
Returns the current reflection and token supplies for the rate computation.
Fallback receive function that accepts ETH sent to the contract.
Returns the token balance of an account by converting its reflections.
Owner-only function that clears _owner and emits an ownership transfer.
Private helper writing _allowances after zero-address checks.
External Uniswap call executed before state finalization with an attacker-independent deadline.
Raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet; may execute the recipient's fallback and reenter.
Unbounded external approval granted to the router on the pair token.
External liquidity addition sending the whole contract ETH balance with a timestamp deadline.
External factory call creating the liquidity pair whose result is trusted.
Sender address parameter of _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer, propagated into _getValues.
Token amount parameter of swapTokensForEth passed to the router.
Recipient parameter of the public transfer function.
Contract token balance computed in _transfer and passed to swapTokensForEth.
Reflection rate cached in _getValues and _takeTeam.
Token fee value returned from _getTValues and consumed by _reflectFee.
Team fee value returned from _getTValues and consumed by _takeTeam.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer origin in the public transfer function.
msg.sender value is bound to the from parameter of _transfer.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the sender for fee and tax decisions.
msg.sender is stored into _owner during construction.
from parameter drives the branch logic and fee selection in _transfer.
to parameter controls the pair/tax branch inside _transfer.
amount parameter is the value transferred through _transfer.
amount is propagated to _getValues for fee computation.
tokenAmount is supplied to the router swap call.
amount is forwarded to the fee wallet transfer.
recipient parameter is passed from transfer into _transfer.
contractTokenBalance computed in _transfer is swapped for ETH.
currentRate is used inside _getValues to derive reflection amounts.
tFee is accumulated into _tFeeTotalAmt via _reflectFee.
tTeam is credited to the contract via _takeTeam.
_transfer writes the tax fee percentage state variable.
_transfer writes the team fee percentage state variable.
_transfer checks the inSwap guard before performing the swap.
_transfer gates the swap on swapEnabled.
_transfer calls balanceOf to size the swap.
_transfer reads _isnotTaxed to decide fee treatment.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap router state variable.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading flips the tradingOpen flag.
openTrading enables the swap feature.
openTrading resets the max transaction amount.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances.
_takeTeam adds team reflections to _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotalAmt.
_reflectFee adds tFee to the accumulated fee total.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain supplies.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotalAmt for the rate computation.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
approve delegates execution to the _approve helper.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
_transferStandard takes the team fee.
_transferStandard reflects the fee.
_transferStandard consumes the values returned by _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token values.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection values.
_getValues calls _getRate for the conversion rate.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth, which performs an external swap.
_transfer calls sendToFee, which performs an external ETH transfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap before state is settled.
sendToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
_walletAddrForFee is the destination of the ETH transfer.
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair.
openTrading adds liquidity through the router.
openTrading grants an unlimited approval on the pair token.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
ETH transfer to the fee wallet can reenter the payable receive function.
Router swap returns ETH to the contract, triggering receive().
The unlimited approval is applied to the uniswapV2Pair token.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts openTrading to the stored owner.
balanceOf converts _rOwned reflections into a token balance.
_feeForAddress1 is consumed by _getTValues as the tax fee.
_feeForAddress2 is consumed by _getTValues as the team fee.
